# Design problems by level

## LLD
| Level | Problems |
|---|---|
| Beginner | Parking lot · Tic-tac-toe · Library management · Vending machine |
| Intermediate | Splitwise (expense sharing) · Elevator system · Snake and ladder · Movie ticket booking (BookMyShow-style) |
| Advanced | Rate limiter (class design) · In-memory key-value store with TTL · Logger framework · Ride matching (core classes) |

## HLD
| Level | Problems |
|---|---|
| Beginner (fresher) | URL shortener · Pastebin · Rate limiter (distributed) · Notification service |
| Intermediate (SDE-1/1+ yrs) | Chat app (WhatsApp-style) · News feed · Food delivery order tracking · Web crawler |
| Advanced (SDE-2+) | Video streaming platform · Ride-hailing dispatch · Distributed cache · Payment system with exactly-once semantics · Search autocomplete at scale |

For each problem, have ready before starting: the 3–4 core functional requirements, realistic scale numbers to hand out when asked, the 2 most interesting deep-dive areas, and 3 pushback scenarios.
